work_completed: Two blocked reports audited and converted into bounded reviewable execution plans; no E2E/nativePASS claim

shared.authority: Verification plan proposal only; no architecture approval, formal test/harness/source edits, native UI actions or real Agent/network execution.
shared.existing_evidence: Prior cargo/module/browser gates remain module-local or actual frontend/mockIPC; none proves full system or native Tauri.

diagrams.boundary:
Operator / future test driver
  ↓ existing UI or HOST driving adapter
  ↓ existing command/use-case ports
  ↓ HOST / SPEC / EXEC / EVID / FLOW (each retains ownership)
  ↓ existing output ports
  ↑ filesystem / process adapters
Native view additionally: Tauri WebView → real invoke bridge → registered command → HOST.
Test fixtures/evidence live outside production project data.
diagrams.dependencies:
Design document projection → module packet (source+SHA) → approved execution request → run event projection → evidence/report ingestion → acceptance policy
Existing local libraries prove segments only; missing approved readiness/UI/Agent/ingress contracts are explicit gates, never guessed links.
UI projection ← real command DTOs ← HOST authoritative state; UI never owns approval/lease.
Filesystem adapter owns persistence operation; no test writes bypass domain mutation ports.

isolation: Unique disposable root per scenario under OS temp with run UUID; no production project or board file edits
Copy fixtures, record original fixture SHA256, keep product input .ess read-only; persist outputs only in disposable root/evidence directory
Use isolated settings path only through supported product configuration; if no supported isolation seam exists classify ARCHITECTURE_GAP and propose smallest seam before implementation
No real Agent, external provider or forbidden8787/8788 endpoints; DryRun/scriptedlocal execution explicitly labeled
Capture start/end source SHA, HEAD+dirty tree, OS/toolchain/WebView metadata; distinguish build under test from workspace HEAD
Cleanup only verified disposable roots after evidence retained; permission tests use controlled fixture failure, never machine-wide ACL change

failure_taxonomy.PRODUCT_FAIL: Observable result contradicts approved contract with reproducible controlled fixture
failure_taxonomy.ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED: Toolchain/WebView/permissions/native automation unavailable; NOT RUN for affected behavior
failure_taxonomy.SPEC_CONFLICT: Different authoritative docs disagree; stop affected slice
failure_taxonomy.ARCHITECTURE_GAP: Required mutation/isolation/provenance seam absent; no speculative test-only production bypass
failure_taxonomy.DEPENDENCY_NOT_READY: Missing approved module contract/readiness; future end-to-end execution NOT RUN
failure_taxonomy.FLAKY_UNRESOLVED: Repeat controlled reproduction; do not treat retryPASS as clean acceptance

shared.no_overdesign: 0 new production types/ports/crates/services/frameworks proposed. Reuse existing tests, commands and report format; at most one future system test file and one native evidence checklist/script only after chosen native surface actually supports it. No universal provider runner.

cards.execution: NOT_RUN_END_TO_END; module regression evidence retained separately
cards.intent: Verify semantic/provenance continuity across approved module boundaries and no accidental product green.
cards.ownership: Parent integration owns only inter-module assertions; child modules retain contracts/BDD/TDD and implementation. No parent duplicate state store.

dependencies.required: approved source/revision/readiness binding; current read-only .ess packet is always NOT_READY
approved local/scripted execution boundary; real external Agent not implied
approved report identity, trust/freshness and rejection contract

minimal_slices.kind: Can plan now; execution approval needed
minimal_slices.scope: Fixture/identity inventory and existing module regression reuse; establish exact source/module/task/run/evidence ID table without adding schema
minimal_slices.output: Versioned fixture inventory, expected rejection statuses and evidence directory; classify missing mappings

minimal_slices.scope: One controlled local happy path using existing approved ports; .ess source→packet→task→DryRun/local run→ingress→evidence→owner acceptance gate
minimal_slices.output: Machine-checked ID/hash continuity and event ordering; simulation explicitly labeled

minimal_slices.scope: Stale source, wrong task/run/report binding, execution failure, cancel, approved expiry and restart cases; no new retry semantics
minimal_slices.output: Per-case deterministic assertions and unchanged source/preexisting state snapshots

minimal_slices.scope: Child module regressions and parent integration suite; compare acceptance projection before/after; owner decides release
minimal_slices.output: PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT RUN matrix with exact build binding

bdd.given: Approved isolated design/module/task fixture and ready dependency revisions
bdd.when: A controlled local run reports through approved ingress
bdd.then: SourceSHA/revision/module/task/run/evidence identities match exactly and provider success alone never sets product green

bdd.given: A packet from source revision A and source changed to B
bdd.then: Stale request is rejected before execution and no run/evidence success is manufactured

bdd.given: An approved run and an unrelated report identity
bdd.then: Wrong task/run/version binding is rejected and existing evidence/state remain unchanged

bdd.given: A controlled running or draining task
bdd.when: Execution fails or cancellation is requested
bdd.then: Captured chunks precede one terminal, lease releases only at terminal and product does not turn green

bdd.when: Its declared expiry boundary is reached
bdd.then: The owning module expiry contract governs rejection/reconcile; no process-drain timeout is substituted for authorization expiry

bdd.given: A previous run finished and events/evidence reconciled
bdd.then: New run identity is distinct and previous evidence cannot authorize the new run

fixtures: Valid selected module and unrelated-secret sentinel .ess from existing packet fixture; copies+hashes
Malformed/stale .ess, wrong module/task/run identity, duplicate/conflicting report fixtures only per ingress contract
Scripted child success/failure/cancel/late-output from existing process tests; no remote CLI
Approved-clock expiry fixture only after actual owner expiry semantics identified; no numerical expiry invented
observations: Input source before/after SHA256; packet source hash/payloadhash; moduleId distinct slotId
Task binding, runID, event sequence and exactly-one terminal; evidence/report IDs and source revision
Pre/post authoritative state projection and WORK lease; acceptance response and green count; original persisted files byte equality on rejection
Logs must label simulated provider vs real process, and local vs end-to-end coverage
ac: Each SYS-B1..B6 has one executable parent-owned assertion or explicit dependency gate NOT RUN; no silent omission
At least success/stale/wrongbinding/fail/cancel/expiry/restart paths demonstrate required identity/state invariants
Existing .ess NOT_READY cannot be bypassed; approved readiness source is prerequisite
Failures preserve previous valid state per child contract; no auto-green from provider success
Exact fixture/source/build hashes, command/exit/log/testmapping retained; environment failures classified separately
All child regressions pass or individually classified; parent acceptance remains separate
cards.owner_decision: Approve this bounded verification plan and dependency order; do not approve missing readiness/schema/Agent/ingress architecture implicitly. Exact expiry authority must be named before SYS-B5 test implementation.

cards.execution: NATIVE_NOT_RUN; no native window launched or controlled
cards.intent: Prove actual Tauri WebView/real IPC/persist-reopen/error/state projection; distinguish it from existing browser mockedIPC.
cards.existing_native_path: tauri.conf.json withGlobalTauri=true; registered scene_save/scene_load/uidesign_save_design/uidesign_load_design; app.js uses global invoke. Missing @tauri-apps/api package alone is not a blocker and does not justify new SDK.

dependencies.required: corresponding integration fixture baseline; owner may approve staged native transport/persistence smoke separately without claiming complete system loop

ui_schema.existing_controls: Existing project binding, scene/UI-design load/save, run status/log/Assign/Cancel; no new controls or fields
ui_schema.normal: Native action invokes registered command, reflects returned state and persists in isolated project
ui_schema.invalid: Path outside declared project, malformed document, missing root/input => readable error, prior active state unchanged
ui_schema.pending: Assign/cancel retains current run projection until actual terminal; repeated Assign blocked while active
ui_schema.failure: Controlled save denial/invalidload must not overwrite old file or clear valid state
ui_schema.reopen: Close/reopen native app with isolated project and reload saved artifact; compare canonical semantic state and persisted byte/hash expectations
ui_schema.accessibility: Use existing labels/focus/buttons; record keyboard reachability only on actual native surface, no redesign

minimal_slices.output: Toolchain/WebView/buildhash+fixture snapshots; supported isolation seam confirmed

minimal_slices.output: Native window screenshot/video+process identity+host action/result evidence. If available automation cannot see native WebView, operator follows fixed checklist; no browser substitution

minimal_slices.scope: Scene and UI-design save/load/invalid/failure/reopen using existing commands and approved contract
minimal_slices.output: Before/after files+state projections and native action observations

minimal_slices.scope: Native run emptypoll/cancel/tailterminal and repeatAssign/restart; local approved fixtures only
minimal_slices.output: Native visible log/order/status and host lease/terminal projection; no real provider

bdd.given: The identified native Tauri build opens an isolated approved project
bdd.when: The operator performs an existing load/query action
bdd.then: Real registered IPC returns project state and native UI displays it with no mocked bridge

bdd.given: A valid scene/UI design with recorded semantic state
bdd.when: It is saved and loaded through native controls
bdd.then: Disk artifact and UI/HOST projections agree per existing format contract

bdd.given: Valid active state and malformed or out-of-root input
bdd.when: The native load/save action is attempted
bdd.then: Readable rejection appears and original valid state/file remains unchanged

bdd.given: An existing persisted valid artifact and a controlled write-denied fixture
bdd.then: Old artifact hash remains valid and failure is visible without success indication

bdd.when: The native app closes and reopens the saved artifact
bdd.then: Canonical scene/UI state matches the saved state; assumptions about auto-restore are not invented

bdd.given: A local controlled run with delayed output
bdd.when: It is cancelled and Assign pressed while draining
bdd.then: Native UI stays active, tail appears once before true terminal and a new run is allowed afterward

native_evidence_protocol: Before launch: exact executable/build SHA, sourceHEAD+dirtytree, OS/WebView, isolatedroot, originalfixture hashes
Record native window/process identity and actual user actions; no injected __TAURI__, file:// browser or :8770 substitute
For each action pair native visible state screenshot/video with real HOST command result/log if supported; disk hash alone or screenshot alone cannot prove whole flow
Use existing logging/export surfaces; if command correlation unavailable, classify missing seam and propose minimal instrumentation separately; no hidden implementation here
Save retained scenario transcript with timestamps, input/output file hashes, state projection, error text and native reopen evidence
Native automation tool must actually support Tauri WebView on this machine; choose existing tool or manual operator checklist first, no universal harness framework
ac: Every NATIVE-B1..B6 has native action+realIPC/state evidence or explicitly NOT RUN; mockedIPC/browser tests cannot satisfy it
No monkeypatch/proxy/mock Tauri bridge in native proof
Save/load semantic equality and failure state/file preservation measured; user-visible errors captured
Reopen proof uses isolated test settings/project, not production user data
No network Agent/runtime permission bypass; native run tests localfixture and correctly labeled
UI architecture and schema unchanged; any missing supported isolation/observability seam returns ARCHITECTURE_GAP before code
Full native/system acceptance requires dependencies; staged smoke status remains PARTIAL until all required cases satisfied
cards.owner_decision: Approve minimal native evidence checklist/fixture plan and staged transport/persistence smoke, keeping full UI behavior/system cases dependency-gated. Before execution identify available native control/observation capability; absence is environment NOT RUN, never browser PASS.
